import os, re, glob

base = "/online1/ycsc_chenkh/hitici_07/deepseek-harness/attached_files/task_11"

def extract_native(path):
    text = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read()
    # Find the "NATIVE RECORD" section (second occurrence typically, or first)
    # Use the section after "NATIVE RECORD" header up to next section header
    m = re.search(r'NATIVE RECORD\s*\n(.*?)(?:\n[A-Z][A-Z ]+\s*\n|\Z)', text, re.S)
    if m:
        return m.group(1).strip()
    return text.strip()[:400]

# Build map record_id -> (role, native text)
roles = ['identity_crosswalk','operative_authority','current_operations','approval_and_capacity',
         'correspondence','financial_or_population_support','chronology_and_custody','independent_counterrecord']

recs = {}
for path in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(base, "*", "*_source_export.*"))):
    if path.endswith('.xlsx'):
        continue
    text = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read()
    rid = re.search(r'CB-DOC-061-(\d+)', text)
    if not rid:
        continue
    rid = 'CB-DOC-061-' + rid.group(1)
    role = None
    for r in roles:
        if r in text:
            role = r
            break
    native = extract_native(path)
    recs[rid] = (role, native)

# Print the four core records for each key
core = ['identity_crosswalk','operative_authority','current_operations','approval_and_capacity']
from collections import defaultdict
by_key = defaultdict(dict)
for rid, (role, native) in sorted(recs.items()):
    n = int(rid.split('-')[-1])
    # key index: records 001-012 -> keys 01-12 (identity); 013-024 -> keys 01-12 (operative); etc.
    # Actually map: record number r, key = ((r-1) % 12) + 1, role_index = (r-1)//12
    key_idx = ((n-1) % 12) + 1
    role_idx = (n-1) // 12
    key = f"CBP-061-{key_idx:02d}"
    role_name = roles[role_idx] if role_idx < len(roles) else role
    by_key[key][role_name] = (rid, native)

for key in sorted(by_key):
    print("="*110)
    print("KEY:", key)
    for r in core:
        if r in by_key[key]:
            rid, native = by_key[key][r]
            print(f"\n  [{r}] {rid}")
            print("   " + native.replace("\n", "\n   "))
        else:
            print(f"\n  [{r}] MISSING")
"}
